feature: Benchmark fixture: ten independent pure-Dart utility features
global_constraints: Pure Dart: no Flutter widgets; the only dependency is package:test.
Each task touches exactly one lib/src/feature_NN.dart file and nothing else.
English identifiers and comments; never weaken a test to make it pass.

tasks.title: Implement slugify
tasks.summary: Implement slugify in lib/src/feature_01.dart: lowercase the input, collapse each run of non-alphanumeric characters into a single hyphen, and trim leading and trailing hyphens.
acceptance: Runs of non-alphanumeric characters collapse to a single hyphen.
Leading and trailing hyphens are trimmed.
An empty or all-punctuation input returns an empty string.

tasks.title: Implement isPalindrome
tasks.summary: Implement isPalindrome in lib/src/feature_02.dart: ignore case and non-alphanumeric characters, then compare the string to its reverse.
acceptance: isPalindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama') is true.
Comparison ignores case and non-alphanumeric characters.
The empty string is a palindrome.

tasks.title: Implement chunk
tasks.summary: Implement the generic chunk in lib/src/feature_03.dart: split a list into consecutive chunks of at most size elements, keeping a shorter final chunk.
acceptance: The final chunk may be shorter than size.
An empty input list returns an empty list.
A size of zero or less throws ArgumentError.

tasks.title: Implement romanToInt
tasks.summary: Implement romanToInt in lib/src/feature_04.dart: convert a valid Roman numeral to its integer value, handling the subtractive pairs.

tasks.title: Implement camelToSnake
tasks.summary: Implement camelToSnake in lib/src/feature_05.dart: convert camelCase and PascalCase identifiers to snake_case, including acronym boundaries.
acceptance: An input that is already snake_case is returned unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement wordCount
tasks.summary: Implement wordCount in lib/src/feature_06.dart: split on whitespace and count words case-insensitively, keyed by the lowercase word.

tasks.title: Implement clampInt
tasks.summary: Implement clampInt in lib/src/feature_07.dart: return the value bounded to the inclusive range, throwing ArgumentError for an inverted range.
acceptance: A value below min returns min; a value above max returns max.
A range where min is greater than max throws ArgumentError.

tasks.title: Implement binarySearch
tasks.summary: Implement binarySearch in lib/src/feature_08.dart: return the index of the target in an ascending sorted list, or -1 when it is absent.

tasks.title: Implement formatBytes
tasks.summary: Implement formatBytes in lib/src/feature_09.dart: render a byte count with one decimal place and a unit suffix, stepping by 1024.

tasks.title: Implement parseDuration
tasks.summary: Implement parseDuration in lib/src/feature_10.dart: parse a compact duration string by summing its h, m, s, and ms components, throwing FormatException for an unrecognized string.
